parameters.query: SELECT id FROM criminal_references WHERE url = $1 OR (doi IS NOT NULL AND doi = $2)

INSERT INTO criminal_references (
  title, title_ar, authors, publication_date, source_type, source_name,
  url, doi, crime_type, geographical_scope, region, language,
  abstract, abstract_ar, keywords, citation_apa, citation_harvard,
  relevance_score, notes
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4::date, $5::source_type_enum, $6,
  $7, $8, $9::crime_type_enum[], $10::geographical_scope_enum, $11::region_enum[], $12,
  $13, $14, $15, $16, $17,
  $18, $19
) RETURNING id, title, citation_apa

parameters.query: UPDATE criminal_references SET last_accessed = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, access_count = access_count + 1 WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO criminal_references (
  title, title_ar, authors, publication_date, source_type, source_name,
  url, doi, crime_type, geographical_scope, region, language,
  abstract, keywords, citation_apa, citation_harvard, relevance_score
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4::date, $5::source_type_enum, $6,
  $7, $8, $9::crime_type_enum[], $10::geographical_scope_enum, $11::region_enum[], $12,
  $13, $14, $15, $16, $17
) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT unique_url_or_doi DO UPDATE SET
  last_accessed = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id
